samples.title: Điện thoại trong lớp
samples.prompt: In the context of smartphones in the classroom, phone rules are sometimes unclear or applied differently in each lesson. What problems can this create, and how could they be reduced?
requirementsVi: Phân tích tác hại, không thay bằng chỉ kể nguyên nhân.
Đưa giải pháp tương ứng.
Giải thích cách đánh giá giải pháp có ích.
samples.summaryVi: Điện thoại có ích khi có nhiệm vụ rõ; thông báo và luật dùng không rõ dễ gây xao nhãng.

paragraphs.label: Mở bài
paragraphs.text: The fact that phone rules are sometimes unclear or applied differently in each lesson can create difficulties in the context of smartphones in the classroom. A useful idea may fail to help the people it is intended for. It is therefore important to examine the practical problems and suggest changes that deal with them directly.
paragraphs.noteVi: Giới thiệu tình trạng và yêu cầu bàn tác hại.

paragraphs.label: Vấn đề và ảnh hưởng
paragraphs.text: A difficulty that should not be ignored is that notifications can distract students. This matters because a device used for learning also gives access to games and private messages. For instance, a pupil may stop following a discussion after receiving several messages from friends. The result may be frustration or a decision to stop taking part. This is not simply a question of people refusing to make an effort; practical conditions can prevent a reasonable idea from working as intended.
paragraphs.noteVi: Nêu tác hại với người cụ thể.

paragraphs.label: Giá trị bị bỏ lỡ
paragraphs.text: Another concern is that the potential benefit may not be realised. The original aim is useful because students can quickly access useful learning material. For example, a class can compare two digital maps to explain how a neighbourhood has changed. When the arrangement does not work, people may lose this opportunity as well as the time they have already spent trying to participate. This can make them less willing to try again.
paragraphs.noteVi: Phát triển hệ quả: mất cơ hội và sự tin tưởng.

paragraphs.label: Giải pháp
paragraphs.text: A practical response would be to agree on specific times for phone use and keep devices away during other tasks. For example, a teacher could allow phones for a five-minute research task and then ask students to put them in their bags. This approach is useful because it deals with a specific obstacle instead of simply repeating a general message. It could first be tried on a small scale, with feedback from the people involved, and then adjusted if some needs have been overlooked.
paragraphs.noteVi: Cách làm trực tiếp giảm trở ngại.

paragraphs.label: Kết bài
paragraphs.text: In conclusion, the main problems include the possibility that notifications can distract students and that a useful opportunity is lost. A response based on practical needs, such as the decision to agree on specific times for phone use and keep devices away during other tasks, is more likely to help than simply repeating that the original idea is worthwhile.
paragraphs.noteVi: Chốt vấn đề và giải pháp, không mở ý mới.

samples.title: Trò chơi điện tử
samples.prompt: In the context of video games in free time, families sometimes set limits without discussing how the activity works. What problems can this create, and how could they be reduced?
requirementsVi: Phân tích tác hại, không thay bằng chỉ kể nguyên nhân.
Đưa giải pháp tương ứng.
Giải thích cách đánh giá giải pháp có ích.
samples.summaryVi: Cân bằng chơi game cần thỏa thuận thời gian thực tế và giữ trách nhiệm học, ngủ, vận động.

paragraphs.label: Mở bài
paragraphs.text: The fact that families sometimes set limits without discussing how the activity works can create difficulties in the context of video games in free time. A useful idea may fail to help the people it is intended for. It is therefore important to examine the practical problems and suggest changes that deal with them directly.
paragraphs.noteVi: Giới thiệu tình trạng và yêu cầu bàn tác hại.

paragraphs.label: Vấn đề và ảnh hưởng
paragraphs.text: A difficulty that should not be ignored is that an unrealistic rule may lead to arguments rather than better habits. This matters because parents and children may disagree about when an online match can reasonably be stopped. For instance, a parent may demand an immediate stop in the middle of a team game that was arranged in advance. The result may be frustration or a decision to stop taking part. This is not simply a question of people refusing to make an effort; practical conditions can prevent a reasonable idea from working as intended.
paragraphs.noteVi: Nêu tác hại với người cụ thể.

paragraphs.label: Giá trị bị bỏ lỡ
paragraphs.text: Another concern is that the potential benefit may not be realised. The original aim is useful because players can enjoy a hobby while still making time for other needs. For example, a teenager can play with friends after finishing homework and still join a weekend football match. When the arrangement does not work, people may lose this opportunity as well as the time they have already spent trying to participate. This can make them less willing to try again.
paragraphs.noteVi: Phát triển hệ quả: mất cơ hội và sự tin tưởng.

paragraphs.label: Giải pháp
paragraphs.text: A practical response would be to agree on realistic finishing times and responsibilities before play begins. For example, a family could decide on a final match and keep the same bedtime on school nights. This approach is useful because it deals with a specific obstacle instead of simply repeating a general message. It could first be tried on a small scale, with feedback from the people involved, and then adjusted if some needs have been overlooked.
paragraphs.noteVi: Cách làm trực tiếp giảm trở ngại.

paragraphs.label: Kết bài
paragraphs.text: In conclusion, the main problems include the possibility that an unrealistic rule may lead to arguments rather than better habits and that a useful opportunity is lost. A response based on practical needs, such as the decision to agree on realistic finishing times and responsibilities before play begins, is more likely to help than simply repeating that the original idea is worthwhile.
paragraphs.noteVi: Chốt vấn đề và giải pháp, không mở ý mới.
